headline: Bring Rheem EcoNet heaters and thermostats into view
intro: Connect a Rheem EcoNet account to Home Assistant through the cloud. The integration discovers water heaters and thermostats, then uses EcoNet MQTT push updates for their changing readings.
highlights: Adjust water-heater target temperature and supported operating modes, and toggle away mode when the heater exposes it
Control thermostat heat, cool, or auto targets, with fan settings and humidity control available on supported models
Review available hot water, tank and compressor health, water and energy use, and diagnostic readings when the equipment provides them

flow.title: From EcoNet account to equipment controls
stages: Enter EcoNet email and password; Home Assistant checks the credentials
Load the account's water heaters and thermostats
Use the available controls and readings as EcoNet sends updates
